ValidationRule.description: it must contain letters and/or digits only its length must be between 3 and 100 characters
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
Not(Isnew()), NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), CONTAINS(Pricebook2.Name, 'Engagement'), NOT(ISBLANK(ER_Customer_Domain__c)), NOT( AND(
LEN(ER_Customer_Domain__c) >= 3, LEN(ER_Customer_Domain__c) <= 100, NOT( REGEX( ER_Customer_Domain__c, ".*([/'().: _$&#@! é§èç{}à%ùäëüï]|\\[|\\]).*" ) ) ) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Customer Domain contains invalid characters. The following characters are not allowed: / ' . ( ) [ ] : _ $ & # @ ! (space) é § è ç { } à % ù ä ë ü ï. The value must be between 3 and 100 characters."
